stories.headline: The Asian Games open in Nagoya, and the host takes the first gold
stories.summary: The 20th Asian Games have opened in Nagoya, in Japan's Aichi Prefecture. Emperor Naruhito declared the Games open. The first gold medal went to the Japanese triathlete Takumi Hojo.

stories.headline: Joey Logano wins the night race at Bristol
stories.summary: Joey Logano has won the Bass Pro Shops Night Race at Bristol Motor Speedway in Bristol, Tennessee. It was held on 19 September and was the 29th race of the NASCAR Cup Series season. Kyle Larson finished second and Carson Hocevar third.

stories.headline: Michelle Bachelet leaves the race to lead the United Nations
stories.summary: Michelle Bachelet of Chile has withdrawn from the race to become Secretary-General of the United Nations, saying she had lost support. She added that the latest informal poll puts Rebeca Grynspan of Costa Rica in the lead.

stories.headline: Thirteen fatty acids give each cat its own scent
stories.summary: Researchers led by Iwate University have studied how cats tell one another apart by the smell of urine. They identified 13 branched-chain fatty acids whose mixture varies from one cat to the next, while staying much the same in a single animal. The compounds turned up in the kidney and in none of the other tissues examined.
